news.title: Nobody’s a loser: What genuine education leaders realize
news.summary_en: My father, Jake M. Schrum, would take me with him to cattle shows and sales. As an impressionable teenager, I treasured these outings mostly to have one-on-one time with my dad, but also, to learn about Hereford cattle and how to judge them.

news.title: Beyond governance: Purpose, ethics, visibility, assurance, and compliance in the age of AI
news.summary_en: Higher education continues to treat AI as just another technology to be deployed, managed, and governed. That assumption is increasingly inadequate.
